# Remember

> Remember is a spaced repetition web app for people studying for exams, or for anything they want to keep long term. You add a topic and your notes, and it brings each topic back just before you'd forget it.

No flashcards to write: you add what you studied, and each day shows what to recall. You say how long you need to remember a topic: a set time, until a date such as your exam, or for good. Each review is rated Forgot, Partly or Remembered, and that sets when the topic comes back.

It's built on the forgetting curve, found by the psychologist Hermann Ebbinghaus in the 1880s: we forget fast unless we go back to what we learned, and each time we recall something we forget it more slowly.

It runs in the browser on phones and computers, can be installed to the Home Screen, works offline, and can send one reminder a day. It's free to get started.
